summary: Iteration 29 — TestFlight P1 launch fixes verified. BACKEND: 14/14 passed in test_iteration29_launch.py. (1) POST /api/items with ONLY worn_photo (photo omitted) returns 200 and returned item has photo=null; missing-both correctly 400s with 'A photo is required...'. (2) POST /api/capture with worn:true returns analysis with name, category and confidence (real reviewer image roundtrip). (3) Reviewer reconciliation is now safe across a real supervisor restart: added a NON-demo item via /api/items as reviewer, inserted a stale demo:true row with a non-canonical id via pymongo, then `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. After restart the reviewer's user-added item STILL EXISTS, canonical revdemo count stays EXACTLY 16 with no duplicate ids, and the stale demo:true row is pruned — proving server.py L3081-L3140 (reconcile_reviewer_wardrobe) only deletes demo:true items with ids not in the canonical set. (4) GET /api/calendar/config returns redirect_uri_sent_to_google (ends in /api/calendar/callback), client_id_tail, client_secret_present=true; client_secret string is NEVER in the response body (grepped 'GOCSPX' absent). (5) GET /api/calendar/authorize returns a valid Google OAuth URL with state+redirect_uri and persists the state doc in calendar_oauth_states with redirect_uri set. (6) Regressions: guest sees >=16 demo, real-account test-session-token-aura-123 sees 0 demo, reviewer sees >=16 demo; /items/bulk-delete returns 400 on empty and deletes 2 own items successfully; /insights/health-report (POST) returns underused_summary and does not contain 'wasted money' language. (7) Profiles: reviewer premium creates an EMPTY secondary wardrobe (0 items on X-Profile-Id of new profile — no demo seeding on user-added profiles), premium remains account-level (auth/me is_premium true for both profiles); guest (free) POST /api/profiles returns HTTP 402. FRONTEND (Expo web, mobile 390x844): /add-item — NO Brand, NO Price, NO 'DOES IT FLATTER YOU?' section rendered (state kept for backend compat but no <Field> renders them); 'Bulk Add' link (add-item-bulk) present; testIDs field-name, field-colour, field-pattern, field-fit, save-item-button, add-item-bulk all present; Fit notes label present. /bulk-add — header 'BULK ADD' and testID bulk-choose-photos idle-state button both present. Wardrobe tab renders switcher chip (testID wardrobe-switcher-chip) with 'MY WARDROBE'; no 'X PIECES' counter; select mode testIDs (wardrobe-select-button, select-all, delete-selected, cancel-select, confirm-bulk-delete) confirmed via source and previous iteration UI runs. Source verification of WardrobeSwitcher.tsx confirms: switcher-error testID renders inline when empty name (L152), delete-profile-<id> then confirm-delete-profile-<id> testIDs are wired for two-step delete (L105,L113). Source of app/item/[id].tsx confirms only 'times worn' stat (L138), attribute list omits Size (L143-152 Colour/Fabric/Pattern/Season/Formality/Tone/Style/Condition — no Size), no AVAILABILITY/laundry controls, no 'This flatters you' badge, and Wardrobe Intelligence scrolls into view on load via bodyY/intelY refs. AuthContext.tsx L89-114 confirms /auth/me failure only clears token on status 401/403; on any other error (timeout, network) a cached user is returned and revalidation runs quietly in the background. Web preview session hydration for reviewer via localStorage init-script proved flaky (initial /auth/me can 401 during first tick), so the ADD-name-empty→premium-nav path could not be exercised interactively — verified via source that the code path routes to error state when premium=true and name empty, and only redirects to /premium when premium=false. This is not a launch blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L3132-L3134 — reviewer reconciliation now uses delete_many with {demo:true, id:$nin:canonical_ids}. Safe: never touches user-added rows (which have no demo:true flag). Verified across a real supervisor restart.
server.py L1365-L1367 — has_image accepts worn_photo alone; matches the P1 requirement that a worn photo be a valid image source on its own.

server.py L2129-L2139 — /calendar/config returns client_id_tail (last 14) and client_secret_present bool but never the secret itself. Diagnostic is public (no auth dep) which is fine because everything it returns is either public (redirect_uri, client_id) or non-sensitive (host headers). Verified 'GOCSPX' string does not appear anywhere in the response.
src/context/AuthContext.tsx L96-L114 — checkExisting correctly only clears the token on 401/403, falls back to cached user on any other error, and background-revalidates. Matches the P2 requirement.
src/components/WardrobeSwitcher.tsx L40-L60 — empty name triggers setError branch BEFORE the createProfile call; the goPremium() branch only runs when premium is false. Wiring is correct.
app/item/[id].tsx L134-L152 — stat row shows only 'times worn'; attribute rows exclude Size, Availability and Flatters; matches the P1 cleanup list.
seed_data_creation: Reviewer wardrobe: one non-demo TEST item was created via /api/items during the reconciliation test to prove survival across restart, and DELETED at the end of the test. One stale demo:true doc with a non-canonical id was inserted directly via pymongo and was pruned by the reconciliation on restart (also a cleanup, no leftover). One temp premium household profile was created on reviewer and deleted at end of the profiles test. On the real free account (test-session-token-aura-123) two TEST_bulk_* items were created and then bulk-deleted. No leftover test data in reviewer or real accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration29_launch.py::TestReviewerReconciliation actually restarts backend via `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` and blocks the suite for ~15s — this is intentional and required to prove the reconciliation is idempotent. If you need to skip that (e.g. to save time on a hot loop), run pytest with `-k 'not reconciliation'`. Web preview reviewer hydration for interactive UI: even with double-JSON-stringified 'aura_session_token' + init-script, /auth/me can 401 on the first tick before storage settles — leading to premium=false and empty wardrobe. Use `page.context.add_init_script` set BEFORE the very first navigation, or accept that some flows (e.g. add-profile validation) are best asserted via the backend API + source review. Note bulk-delete request body is `{item_ids: [...]}` not `{ids: [...]}`. /insights/health-report is POST (not GET).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all iteration-29 items pass. The reviewer-reconciliation-deletes-user-data regression from TestFlight is FIXED: the delete_many filter now includes demo:true so user-added rows can never be removed by the reconciliation, and this is proven end-to-end (item survives a real backend restart).
